marks.gloss_en: דתנן: ... בזיתים -- משתרד רביעה שניה
Rav Zevid: for olives
דאמר מר: מהלכין כל אדם בשבילי הרשות עד שתרד רביעה שניה
Rav Pappa: in order to walk on the permitted paths
דתנן: עד מתי נהנין ושורפין בתבן ובקש של שביעית -- עד שתרד רביעה שניה
Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: for removing the produce of the seventh year
כדרב יהודה, דאמר רב יהודה: מיטרא בעלה דארעא הוא
R' Abbahu: why 'revia'? a thing that couples with (rovea) the ground
דאמר רב יהודה בר יצחק: הני ענני דצפרא לית בהו משש -- so morning rain does not avert 'and He will close up'
Abaye: this was said only before the evening 'and He will close up'; but before the morning one -- it does have 'and He will close up'
דיקא נמי, דכתיב תמטר -- תהא מקום מטר; שמע מינה: the cursed part is the over-rained one
לא קשיא: הא דאתא טובא, הא דאתא כדמבעי ליה (= p_stam_tuva_kidmibei)
no difficulty: this [the curse] where too much came, that [Rav Chisda] where it came as needed
Rav Pappa to Abaye: but people say -- when the doors open [to] rain, donkey-driver, fold your sack and sleep
לא קשיא: הא דקטיר בעיבא, הא דקטיר בענני -- this where [the sky] is covered with eiva, that where it is covered with ananei (Steinsaltz: thick vs light cloud)
the folk saying: when the doors open [to] rain, donkey-driver, fold your sack and sleep
אִינִי? והאמר רב חסדא: טבא לשתא דטבת מנוולתא -- is that so? Rav Chisda said it is good for the year when Tevet is muddied
לא קשיא: הא דאתא מיטרא מעיקרא, הא דלא אתא מיטרא מעיקרא -- this where rain came at the start, that where it did not
Rav Yehuda: good for the year when Tevet is a widow
אִינִי? והכתיב והמטרתי על עיר אחת ועל עיר אחת לא אמטיר, ואמר רב יהודה אמר רב: שתיהן לקללה -- rain on part [of the land] is a curse on both parts
Rav Chisda: rain that fell on part of a country and not on part -- has nothing of 'and He will close up'
רוב ההודאות ולא כל ההודאות? -- 'the abundance of thanksgivings' and not 'all thanksgivings'?
אימא: אל ההודאות -- say 'God of thanksgivings' (= p_rava_el_hahodaot); Rav Pappa then rules both are said (p_pappa_tarvayhu)
Rava: say 'God of thanksgivings'
one who vows 'until the rains': from when rain falls until the second rainfall falls
what are nemoshot? R' Yochanan: old men who walk on a staff
what is the reason? as it is written: 'and for your cattle and for the beast in your land' (Lev 25:7)
R' Abbahu: the first rainfall -- enough to go into the ground a tefach; the second -- enough to seal with it the mouth of a barrel
Rav Chisda: rain that fell before 'and He will close up' [is said] -- has nothing of 'and He will close up'
R' Abbahu: from when does one bless over rain? from when the groom goes out to meet the bride
Rav: 'we thank You, Lord our God, for each and every drop You brought down for us'
